TEXT: A gentle long-lived youkai with powerful strength and the ability to manipulate flowers. NL She came to the spire for fun and exercise her muscles and bones.
NL You smack the heart with you parasol...

Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. NL ~"Join~ ~us~ ~sisters,~ ~and~ ~feel~ ~the~ ~warmth~ ~of~ ~the~ ~Spire."~
